issue.title: Status of testing Providers that were prepared on October 20, 2026
issue.body:
I have a kind request for all the contributors to the latest provider distributions release.
Could you please help us to test the RC versions of the providers?

The guidelines on how to test providers can be found in

[Verify providers by contributors](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_PROVIDERS.md#verify-the-release-candidate-by-contributors)

Let us know in the comments, whether the issue is addressed.

These are providers that require testing as there were some substantial changes introduced:

#74871 verified against `apache-airflow-providers-fab==3.10.2rc1`. It is doc-only, and the permission table in the candidate is correct.

Verified #74711 with `apache-airflow-providers-fab==3.10.2rc1` on Airflow 3.3.2 and Python 3.11.16.

All six scenarios passed on PostgreSQL 16.15 and MySQL 8.0.46. Invalid names leave roles and permissions unchanged. Corrected imports and existing-role handling work as expected.

#74730 works as expected with `apache-airflow-providers-amazon==9.39.0rc1`. Tested on Airflow 3.3.2 (Python 3.12, Breeze) against moto 5.2.3, not a live AWS account.

The check builds a real `EcsRunTaskOperator` with `awslogs_group`, `awslogs_stream_prefix` and `skip_on_exit_code=3`. It runs a moto ECS task, marks the container `STOPPED` with the chosen exit code, and calls `_check_success_task()`. CloudWatch Logs is moto, so a missing stream raises a real `ResourceNotFoundException` from `GetLogEvents`.

| Scenario | 9.38.0 | 9.39.0rc1 |
|---|---|---|
| Missing log stream, exit 3 (in `skip_on_exit_code`) | `ResourceNotFoundException` escapes | Skipped (`AirflowSkipException`) |
| Missing log stream, exit 1 | `ResourceNotFoundException` escapes | Fails with the operator's own `AirflowException` |
| Stream exists, exit 3 | Skipped | Skipped |
| Stream exists, exit 1 | Fails with `AirflowException` | Fails with `AirflowException` |

Not tested: a real ECS/CloudWatch run, and the full `execute()` path (the waiter and the log fetcher thread).
